page.overview:
Who is Ben Hildebrand?

Benjamin "Ben" Hildebrand was the late boyfriend of Amanda Kirby following her divorcement with Paul Kirby, and served as a father figure of sorts to her son Eric Kirby.

Intending to bond with Eric, Ben organized an illegal parasailing tour of Isla Sorna run by Enrique Cardoso. But, due to a freak accident, the boat had crashed, and Ben and Eric were forced to detach well parachuting, becoming stranded on the island; resulting in Ben being killed at some point during this ordeal, leaving Eric to fend for himself in the hostile environment until help had arrived.

At some point, following Amanda Kirby's divorce from her husband Paul, she and Ben met and struck up a romance. He also had bonded, with her son, Eric and became a father-figure of sorts to him.

At some point, in an attempt to further bond with Eric, Ben had offered to take him on an illicit parasailing tour of Isla Sorna, despite knowing full well that the island was strictly off-limits to human exploration. Although well aware of the potential ramifications of the tour, both legal and otherwise, Ben was able to obtain Amanda's permission to take her son on the trip as he had planned, although, whether Amanda knew of the illegal ramifications of the tour, is unknown.
